## Chapter Four

Incarceration



The next few days went by uneventful, when Lucas wasn’t in his cell, he was eating or in the yard, the watchful eyes of the guards or their cameras were always on them. He kept feeling Cold Eyes or Grigor watching him, but he spent all his time with Mouse or talking to mouse, he learned quite a bit about prison life in those first few days. They were kept in separate but smaller cells to keep the violence down and also because of the reduced violence the Department of Security was able to charge more per prisoner to the county, he also learned that Grigor was an expatriate Russian who ran the prison version of the Russian Mob and he was a sociopath, Mouse seemed to have a particular hatred for him. Lucas sensed there was more to the story but didn’t feel it was right to ask the skittish young man about it, Mouse was his only friend and he was desperate for any human interaction. Lucas had no one, his only family left alive had been his father. Now all he had was Mouse



It was on the fourth day that things took a turn for the worse. Lucas and Mouse who when not in there cells had spent every moment together, becoming fast friends, both finding solace in each others company, Lucas could tell he had not fared well but still had not felt comfortable asking the young man about it, He had found out that Mouse was doing a nickel , five years in jail speak for theft, his family was from one of the working class neighborhoods, Lucas had heard about them touted on the news as stable and safe enviroments for employees of the five companies, but Mouse had told a different story, one of low food rations and low pay, his father had died in an accident at work and the state had refused any benefits, leaving his disabled mother on a small stipend of welfare that couldn’t support her three children and herself, so Mouse had resorted to stealing food to ensure that his family survived, he had been caught and since all markets were owned by the Department of Agriculture, it had been a state level crime and the Judge had thrown the book at him. Lucas didn’t understand why they would give him five years for such a meager offense, but then of course he had gotten ten for simply being related to his father.



His emotions had yo-yod over the last few days in reguards to his father, he had gone from love to sadness to hate to well the best he could describe it as was ambivalence, he was here, his father was dead and that was the reality he was living in. “Days kind of Blend together after a while, to the point where you are not sure which day it is, I keep track of days by notching the wall in my cell” Mouse said conversationally as they walked around the exercise yard perimeter, the space was the size of about half a football field and fifty or so of the saucer drones hovered overhead. The two had chosen to walk around the fence avoiding the basketball court and the weight yard which were usually populated, they tried there best to keep there heads down and keep to themselves, Mouse always kept a watchful eye on any group, ready to bolt at the first sign of trouble. “I have noticed that” Lucas said also keeping a watchful eye on the groups of convicts on the court playing a pickup game.



Cold eyes and Grigor had continued to give them hateful looks, whispering in the mess hall when they spotted them, Lucas could tell it was going to come to trouble, all he could do is ensure he stayed in public areas when he was out of his cell. Every cell had a small pop out shower so at least he didn’t have to go to a public bath with these guys, and aside from eating and the yard they were all kept in their cell’s Lucas and Mouse occupied their time talking about pretty much anything using the tapped-out code that mouse had given him.



Along the peremiter of the yard stood a twenty-four-foot concrete wall, there was no view except that of the yard, no breeze because of the size of the wall, so Lucas just enjoyed the sunshine and the ability to be outside for the two hours a day he was allowed. He wasn’t sure if the yard was used in shifts or if they had more then one but the count of people in the yard was never more then fifty when he and Mouse were out, and always seeming the same ones for the last few days, at least from what he could tell. Mouse wasn’t helpful, he had been on this cell block since getting here and had not ventured anyplace else, so knowledge of the layout was incredibly limited. They continued to stroll in silence, trying to catch any errant sounds of the world outside the prison, any noise was welcome, but few seemed to venture in this place almost as if they were on a barren world void of life.



As they made another round of the wall a guard walked over towards them, looking at his tablet he reached shouting distance of the two “Prisoner 811432 and Prison 68314 you are to report to the mess hell for clean up” he stated and made a motion with his hand towards there usual entrance. Lucas looked at Mouse who just shrugged and began walking towards the door, Lucas followed, wondering what the hell clean up entailed. “They grab inmates at random to clean up the mess hall after chow” he whispered as they entered the door.



Lucas felt the hairs on the back of his neck rise as they entered the hallway towards the mess hall. At first, he wasn’t sure what bothered him, but he slowed his pace mouse moving out in front of him, still talking, but Lucas was no longer listening, something was wrong. Squinting his eyes in the dimly lit space his hear began to speed up as he tried to resolve the instinctual fear as adrenaline began to course through his system. As he came to the halfway point he stopped, fear rampant in his body, Mouse slowed and turned, and his eyes became the size of saucers right before pain exploded on the side of Lucas’s head.



Hitting the floor, he tried to focus his eyes as two looming figures stood over him. Dazed his mind tried to make sense of what he was seeing. “See I told you it would be easy, kids are stupid” the first gruff voice said to the second figure, they began to come into focus and Lucas’s heart stopped as cold eyes and Grigor stood over him. He looked around the room for help and he could find Mouse nowhere. “Oh, don’t bother, your friend probably ran and hid somewhere, we will take care of him soon enough” Grigor said menace and intent dripping off of his words.



Cold eyes leaned down and ran his hand over Lucas’s face “I like this one, he is pretty” the thickly accented Russian said softly the look in his eyes driving panic into Lucas, he was old enough to understand the intent but young enough to not believe it would happen to him. “Well, hurry up, the guards won’t be distracted all day” Grigor said, looking over his shoulder at the entrance towards the mess hall. Lucas quickly inhaled to scream but the breath was driven out of him as cold eyes punched him in the stomach “now, now” he said running his hands over the young man’s mid section and then going lower “That would ruin all our fun”. He leered at the young man those cold eyes burning holes in Lucas’s soul as his mind tried to retreat to the coming horror.



“Anton, come on, hurry up” Grigor spat impatiently to his friend. Lucas found himself being rolled over as Anton began to tug at his pants “I own you now” said the husky voice. Lucas couldn’t let this happen, but he was frozen with fear, he tried to struggle only to be pinned by Grigor’s boot as his pants was tugged down. “No, please” he begged tears welling up in his eyes. He could hear the meaty chuckle as Anton laughed.



Lucas closed his eyes to what he knew must be coming next but instead of pain he felt the weight on his back suddenly lift and the sounds of meaty slaps “What the fuck” said a surprised Grigor and then the convict hit the floor directly in Lucas’s limited view, his eyes rolled up into the back of his head, but not dead, Lucas could smell his rancid breath as he continued to breath. And then he heard a second grunt and something heavy hitting the ground behind him. Lucas felt himself lifted off of the cold concrete and then spun to face the old man who had handed him his linens a few days ago. “Go, now to the mess hall, continue as if nothing has happened” the old man urgently said. He quickly looked around and assessed the hall “I will take care of this, we will talk later” he spoke his words urgent and quiet.



Lucas just stood there, not knowing what to do, still trying to comprehend the horrors of what almost happened, he wanted to talk to someone, or sit, he needed to process this. His face exploded with pain as the old man slapped him hard. “Stay with me, I need you to go, NOW” he said Lucas quickly tugging up his pants and quickly moving down the hall. Tears freely running down his cheecks as all of the emotions from the last few minutes seemed to explode into his mind at once.



As he reached the end of the hall, he could move no more, his legs could not carry the weight of his body and so he slumped against the wall, uncontrollable sobs rolling off his body as he cried, cried for himself, for his situation, for the near violation and most of all, for the bleak future that awaited him. And then he was being pulled, Lucas looked up into the grim and fearful face of Mouse “We have to go now” he said gently pulling Lucas to his feet.



With an effort of will he put one foot in front of another and walked into the mess hall. “Where the hell have you too been” came a booming voice from across the hall. Mouse turned stepping on front of Lucas to obscure him from the officer who stood akimbo watching the other convicts present while they went about cleaning the hall. “Sorry boss, my friend slipped so it took us a few moments longer” he said smoothly and without skipping a beat. Mouse carefully took hold of Lucas’s elbow, he cringed away for a moment, Mouse backed off and did his best to not touch his friend as he guided him to a bench. Once he was seated Mouse began to clean the tables furiously “No worries boss, he will be back up in a jiff, ill make sure we don’t fall behind” he stated excitedly to the guard and continued his cleaning frenzy.



Lucas sat like a zombie, his mind unable to process the last twenty minutes, he didn’t care about the guard or even Mouse who had so diligently covered for him. Yes, but where had he gone? Lucas thought. He should have never entered the hallway, he should have seen the danger, he was going to die, Lucas knew he was not prepared for prison, and he would not survive. So, he has, no tears, no emotion, just buried in his thoughts the outside world did not exist. Mouse finished cleaning another thirty minutes later and carefully led his friend back to his cell.



When the doors closed Lucas curled into a fetal position and burst into tears, his mind was in turmoil, he could not process what had almost happened as he rocked himself on the uncomfortable metal bed. At some point he drifted off into a deep sleep.



Sometime later the klaxon tore him out of his rest, looking around it took him a few moments to remember again where he was, and then the horror of earlier settled back in. As the door opened, he was afraid to go out there, he didn’t want to see them, or be near anyone. Curling up on his bed he stared with fear at the door. Wishing the world on the other side away. Mouse peaked his head in “You need to get up, don’t make the guards come in, it never goes well” he whispered urgently. Lucas looked away from his friend a tear escaping his eye. “I can’t, I can’t go out there, I can’t face them” he whispered to the wall. Mouse walked over and sat on the edge of his bed. Looking at his friend he grabbed Lucas’s face and turned it to look at him. Lucas could see the pain and understanding in those fearful eyes “I know, you aren’t the first, I went and got Dyson, I didn’t want it to happen to you” he finished looking down, ashamed.



And then Lucas understood, the fear and paranoia, the meekness sitting forward he saw his friend with new eyes. “What happened” he gently prodded Mouse. The young man got up and walked towards the door, “We need to go, come on” he said almost making it out before Lucas, quickly getting up laid a hand on his friends’ shoulder “What happened mouse?” he prodded. Without turning the young man sighed. “I was owned, until he got bored” he said and then walked out of the room.



They shuffled to the mess hall, Lucas not knowing what to say to his friend, he didn’t understand before now, but it made sense, He would not have been the first and Mouse had saved him, he owed the meek young man his life. As they approached the dining hall Lucas just happen to look across the chasm to the other tier and his blood ran cold as Anton and Grigor were there, shooting icy gazes at the young man, Lucas quickly turned away but he could feel there eyes on him, he knew the intent they held and for a moment he couldn’t breath, knowing if they ever caught him alone again, he would not walk away.



Mouse pushed his friend, urging him forward. Lucas sat through dinner but barely touched his food , he had no appetite and gave most of his food to Mouse who ate with gusto, talking about anything , Lucas knew he was trying to keep his mind off of Anton and Grigor, but it wasn’t working, in fact the thought of those two encompassed his entire throughts all through dinner.



It seemed an eternity until Lucas returned to the solace of his cell, he found it ironic, that it was here that he felt safest. He was tired of thinking, tired of feeling afraid so he just let his mind wander, studying the bland walls to try and make out the contours of the etchings that had been covered by a fresh coat of paint. Tracing his finger along the curves and contours of the depressions as he did.



He lost track of time and nearly jumped out of the bed when his door opened and a guard appeared “Prisoner, I am hear to escort you to your mandatory physical, lets go” he said. Lucas stood shakily and let himself be escorted down the metal walkway, passing the mess hall and into an area he had not seen before. Turning into another identical hall like the entrance to the mess Lucas was guided into a waiting room, the guard showed him in and shut the door, leaving Lucas alone in small empty room.



“We don’t have a lot of time” came a gruff voice from a dark corner causing Lucas to jump. Turning he watched as Dyson emerged from the shadows crossing his arms and leaning against the wall. “What do you want?” Lucas asked, his voice harsh as he tried to mask the fear. “Is that any way to thank the man who saved your life?” Dyson asked a smirk spreading under the salt and pepper beard on his face. “Depends on why, and what you want” the young man asked, facing his would be savoir. Dyson never moved, never advanced and seem to be doing his best to not seem threatening. “I saved you because I owed you” he said his blue eyes assessing his young companion. Lucas turned to face him “what are you talking about?” he was confused, he didn’t know this man, had never seen him before, what could he possibly owe Lucas he wondered as he started at the old man’s face seeing if it registered, seeing if he knew the old man.



Dyson shook his head “We will cover that later, right now I need to know, do you want to survive this? do you want to protect yourself from the likes of Grigor and his goons?” he asked hitting on the main point of hopelessness. Lucas was quiet for a moment, not daring to hope, knowing nothing came without a cost in this place. “What do you want from me?” he asked a hard edge still hiding the fear of realizing, it didn’t matter, Lucas was helpless, locked in a room with a man who had beaten down Grigor and Anton, whatever this man wanted he could just take and The young man knew it and crossed his arms to hide them shaking.



“Nothing like Anton did, I will not hurt you” Dyson said earnestly “Do you want to protect yourself?” he asked again, the question hanging between them. No one spoke the air heavy with the unanswered question. Dyson stood up getting ready to ask again “Yes” Lucas blurted out, closing his eyes and resolving that any cost was worth living, submitting to this man who he didn’t know “I want to live, I am tired of being afraid , I am tired if being prey among stronger predators, I am tired of feeling hopeless” he said his watery but no longer innocent eyes locking on the older and harder ones of the rooms other occupant. Dyson, didn’t speak, only nodded, slowly walking over to the door he banged on it twice “You will be moving cell’s, we will start tomorrow, in the yard” he said and then the door opened, and the guard entered, first nodding at Dyson and then motioning to Lucas to exit.



Confused Lucas walked out of the room and was escorted back to his cell, the Guard never spoke and neither did Lucas. Two hours later he found himself carrying his meager personal belongings to another tier and into a new cell. This cell was bigger, with a set of bunk beds instead of the single bed and laying on the top bunk was Dyson, a chill ran down Lucas’s back as he tried to understand what he had gotten into. Once the cell door closed, he eyed Dyson, half expecting the man to descend from his bed and beat the hell out of him, or worse, but Dyson just laid there staring at him for a moment.



“This is the adult wing, you were in what is called the minor’s wing, they aren’t monsters, they know putting young men together with older monsters won’t end well so they try and keep you separate until your older, I have accelerated there timetable and it wasn’t easy, we start your training tomorrow, get some sleep” Dyson stated and then rolled over to sleep.
